The concrete quadratic irrational equilibrium has a guarded fair-bit implementation with stated tails and conditional cost. General Kakutani existence gives neither effective selection nor convergence, and finite prefixes are not the infinite probability theorem.
The modal/explanatory bridges and independent metaphysical premises are not the ambient self-product closure hypotheses. Neither finite check nor a kernel proof in the other lane discharges them.

Simulation under substrate changes and future-task preservation require realisation and physical/external authority premises absent from the typed versioned wrapper. A currently valid licence is not personal identity or future-generating capability.

The attained-image decoder clause is identical under typed renaming to the surjective factorisation clause. T08 also has universal-family, cardinality and approximate minimax clauses, so whole-family duplication is not established.

Historical d_V(f) is a worst recovery gap for a named finite observable under equal moment summaries. Modern d(nu) is total mass not concentrated on positive singleton cells. Their carriers, quantifiers and extrema differ; neither formula replaces the other.

Finite observable-span closure and predictive memory dimension preserve future branch numerators for all laws. Issued-record freshness instead compares captured version stamps after writes; it does not calculate minimal predictive dimension.

The historical deterministic quotient requires factorisation of update, target and landscape and proves commuting finite iterates. CV-O provides a differently typed operational context/evidence discipline; it does not make the quotient hypotheses automatic.

Both use conditional Kakutani existence over finite declared mixtures. The historical Nash best-response population and the modern term/measure fixed-point domain are different. Neither generic existence statement supplies constructive selection, convergence or the S2 sampler.

The conditional cone theorem requires a nonempty complete actual concrete cone, well-founded dependence and a predecessor for each nonnecessary actual member. It does not validate these premises, identify a unique intelligent bearer or close the controlling B0-B16 bridges.

The actual total-explanation theorem requires completeness, projection and exclusion of same-respect self-explanation. Its mathematical conditional is preserved separately from premise truth and the deductive Necessary-Being status.

The historical combined result adds operator-authorised resource-feasible migration, every required interface, controlled invariant host-excluding support, disturbance assumptions and separate progress/termination obligations. Task continuation alone supplies none of those extra premises.
